title: Cyber Orient — Neon Futures
desc: A deep dive into the Cyber Orient category — where Eastern iconography meets neon-lit futurism. Featuring 12 works from 8 international artists.

title: Sean Own — Silk & Vision
location: Long You Silk Culture Center, Macau
desc: A solo exhibition showcasing founder Sean Own's curatorial vision — from his early merchandising work to the LYS silk art platform. Featured on CGTN French channel.

title: Dunhuang — Silk Road Reimagined
desc: A touring exhibition celebrating Dunhuang frescoes and Silk Road heritage, printed on the very material that once traveled the route. Beijing premiere, then Paris.

title: Legends Gallery — Icons Reimagined
desc: Our Legends Gallery category comes to life — iconic figures from music, sports, film, and philosophy, reimagined by visual artists. Not photographs. Artistic interpretations.

title: The Other Gaze — Western Artists, Eastern Themes
desc: Our inaugural exhibition dedicated to non-Eastern artists interpreting Eastern themes. A bold experiment in cross-cultural artistic dialogue.
